objective: remove provably empty Agent review retries without weakening geometry, class-change, hole, or human-review gates

diagnosis.first_rejection: the model attempted split and reclassify on the same mixed candidate
diagnosis.second_rejection_after_prompt_clarificat: the model attempted to reclassify floor to floor
diagnosis.interpretation: The retry protected real edits, but a reclassification to the candidate's existing label is mathematically incapable of changing class or geometry.

prompt_guard: use each candidate ID in at most one operation per round
never split and reclassify the same ID in one response
never reclassify a mixed-semantics candidate wholesale
accepted_change.deterministic_normalization: Drop only a reclassify operation whose single existing shape ID already has the requested label.
accepted_change.empty_tail_behavior: If no real operation remains and no ground hole or pending SAM comparison exists, normalize continue to done with the existing empty-continue rule.
unchanged_gates: hole coverage and ground-only fill validation

real_edit_regression_guard.interpretation: A real geometry operation was preserved and still requires another observation before acceptance; only the exact no-op class change is removed.

verification.fast_5090_route: disabled while non-owned workloads remain active

limits: The 46.28 percent result is a same-image cold engineering comparison, not a workload-wide latency distribution.
Real edits are not auto-accepted: the camera_2 add_region operation remained subject to the next Agent observation.
No-op normalization improves latency and reliability but does not establish segmentation accuracy on a new factory dataset.
